facts.claim: Norwegian Bliss (Norwegian Cruise Line): Entered service 2018; 168,028 GT; 4004 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 348 m length; Breakaway Plus class.
Norwegian Bliss is a cruise ship for Norwegian Cruise Line, which entered service on 21 April 2018.
The ship was built by Meyer Werft in Papenburg, Germany.
The ship had a schedule of debuting in Alaska, United States in June 2018, and is designed for improved energy efficiency to meet Alaska's environmental regulations.

catalogSpecs.description: Designed for Alaska cruising with a massive observation lounge. Underwent significant refurbishment in early 2025 with upgrades to public areas, specialty restaurants, and new Horizon Park space.
